description: This file defines the class pSpring, which is used to draw spring graphs, including methods for node and link management, layout algorithms, and rendering options in a graph visualization context.

classes.name: pSpring
classes.description: A class to create and draw spring graphs, managing nodes, links, layout calculations, and visualization rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes default node and link properties, labels, and internal data structures.

methods.name: setLinkDefaults
methods.description: Sets default appearance options for links between nodes.

methods.name: setLabelsSettings
methods.description: Configures appearance settings for node labels.

methods.name: autoFreeZone
methods.description: Automatically computes the size of the free zone around nodes based on connections.

methods.name: linkProperties
methods.description: Defines visual properties for links between specific nodes.

methods.name: setNodeDefaults
methods.description: Sets default visual properties for nodes.

methods.name: addNode
methods.description: Adds a new node with specified properties to the graph.

methods.name: setNodesColor
methods.description: Sets color attributes for specified nodes.

methods.name: dumpNodes
methods.description: Returns the current data of all nodes in the graph.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks or creates a connection from one node to another.

methods.name: getMedianOffset
methods.description: Calculates the median position of connected nodes to aid in layout placement.

methods.name: getBiggestPartner
methods.description: Identifies the connected node with the highest weight for layout considerations.

methods.name: firstPass
methods.description: Performs the initial layout calculations based on a specified algorithm.

methods.name: doPass
methods.description: Performs one iteration of the layout adjustment process.

methods.name: lastPass
methods.description: Finalizes node positions and returns conflict metrics.

methods.name: center
methods.description: Centers the entire graph visualization within the view area.

methods.name: drawSpring
methods.description: Performs the layout calculation and rendering of the spring graph, including nodes, links, labels, and optional vectors.

methods.name: getDistance
methods.description: Calculates Euclidean distance between two points.

methods.name: getAngle
methods.description: Computes the angle between two points relative to the x-axis.

methods.name: intersect
methods.description: Detects whether two line segments intersect.
